messages:
sophie: Quick thing — noticed p99/p995 SLOs spike after we widened the coalesce window on a few hosts. Proposing a short-lived 'grace buffer' to absorb very-late arrivals for tiny windows. Thoughts?

tom: Do you mean a per-lane overflow buffer that holds requests for up to N ms before deciding to pack or drain? Might improve packing but could hide real backpressure. Numbers? :thinking:

maya: Concern is starvation. If grace buffer hoards tokens/kvcache entries we could push other tenants to tail. We need clear eviction and fairness rules.

liam: Also KV cache implications — holding more in-flight increases kvcache pinning and memory pressure. Need a knob to cap buffer tokens per-GPU.

sophie: Sketch config we tried locally: ```
# scheduler config
grace_buffer_ms: 40
max_buffer_tokens_per_lane: 256
eviction_policy: lru_soft
early_drain_threshold_pct: 20
```

tom: With early-drain path we can reduce p99 but pay throughput tax. Early-drain triggers when buffer > threshold or when request has tight `deadline_ms`. That lets interactive requests bypass packing.

maya: We should simulate with our replay harness (tenant mixes) before rollout. Metrics to add: `buffer_hold_time`, `buffer_evictions`, `kvcache_pressure`, `packing_efficiency`, `p50/95/99_latency`.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: add feature flag `sched_grace_buffer`, alpha opt-in tenants only, verbose telemetry (buffer_*), rate-limit on alpha.

liam: API surface idea: accept soft hints on enqueue, e.g. `enqueue(req, hint={'deadline_ms':120, 'priority':'interactive'})`. Scheduler can use hint to decide early-drain vs pack.

sophie: Agree. Also fallback: if grace buffer occupancy > 80% for >100ms, force a canary drain to avoid pile-up cascading.

tom: Plan for experiments: (A) enable grace buffer=40ms default, (B) enable early-drain at 20% occupancy, (C) control. Run staged traffic on staging clusters, collect metrics.

maya: Add alert: if `buffer_evictions` > 1% or `kvcache_pressure` rises 25% vs baseline, auto-disable feature flag.

liam: I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with replay sims and microbench results. Anyone object to alpha rollout next week for a handful of tenants? :rocket:

maya: no objections.

sophie: Thanks — will open the feature flag PR and telemetry ticket. Keeping it tight and reversible.
